messages:
sam_dev: Hey team, hitting a weird failure on first call from the sample node app. Using our corp proxy + Okta SSO. Response is 403 with {"error":"billing_required"} even though the org should have trial credits.

maria_dx: are you using a browser session token or a service key? browser tokens often fail for server API calls. paste curl -v output?

sam_dev: curl -v shows the Authorization header present but 403. Body: {"error":"billing_required","message":"workspace not active or missing billing info"}. Token is from the web after Okta redirect.

ton y_se: two things to check: 1) web session tokens are short-lived and tied to cookies; 2) corporate proxies can strip or rewrite Authorization. Try unsetting HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY or add the API host to NO_PROXY.

ton y_se: quick check: `HTTP_PROXY= HTTPS_PROXY= curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <SERVICE_KEY>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` — if that returns 200, proxy was mutating headers.

sam_dev: how do I generate a service key? I don't see it in the console, maybe billing blocked the option.

maria_dx: Console path: Settings -> Developer -> Service keys. Create one called `sample-dev`. If billing is truly disabled you'll still get billing_required, but new orgs should have onboarding credits. Also make sure the sample reads REDWOOD_API_KEY (or REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY depending on sample) and not a browser-only env.

maria_dx: If you're behind a proxy, set `NO_PROXY=api.redwood.example` (or the exact host) in your shell before running the sample so Authorization doesn't get stripped. For node samples confirm `process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` is used.

sam_dev: created a service key and retried with proxies disabled. Success! Got 200 and model output: {"id":"resp_01H3Z8","object":"generation","choices":[{"text":"Hello from Redwood!"}],"model":"rw-1-small"}

sam_dev: so root cause was browser token + proxy. billing page was misleading because org had credits but the token/proxy combo prevented auth.

onboarding-bot: Tip: check onboarding runbook -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onboarding-proxy-okta for proxy, SSO, and service key steps.

maria_dx: can someone add a brief NOTE in the sample-app README about SSO tokens vs service keys and a NO_PROXY example? will save repeat tickets.
sam_dev: will open a PR with exact env var examples and a short troubleshooting checklist.
maria_dx: great, marking resolved, thanks all!
